    • getFirebaseId

      public static com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<String> getFirebaseId()
      Asynchronously retrieves the unique Firebase Installation ID. This ID is unique to the app installation on the device and remains consistent unless the app is uninstalled or the device is factory reset.
      Returns:
      A Task that will resolve to the Firebase Installation ID.
